slides.useAsTemplate: Save as template for new slides
slides.templateHint: New slides start as a copy of this slide as it was when you saved it as template

props.noSelection: Select an element to edit it. Drag on an empty area to select several.
props.editTextHint: Double-click the text (or press Enter) to edit it.

math.editHint: Double-click the equation (or press Enter) to edit it. Drag a corner to scale it.
math.inlineHint: Tip: type $x^2$ in the text to insert a formula.

file.recoverQuestion: Tiza closed without saving changes to “{{name}}”. Recover them?
file.discardRecoverySure: Delete the recovered changes permanently? (Cancel keeps them for next time.)

file.io: The file could not be read or written.
file.notTiza: This is not a Tiza presentation.
file.invalid: The presentation is damaged and cannot be opened.
file.tooNew: This presentation was made with a newer version of Tiza (format {{version}}). Update Tiza to open it.
file.unsafePath: The file contains unsafe paths and was not opened.
file.badExtension: The file name must end in .tiza.

sim.editorHint: One self-contained HTML file (scripts and styles inside).
sim.title: Name
sim.interactHint: Double-click the page to use it (click outside to go back to editing). It is always interactive in presentation mode.
sim.resolutionHint: The page is laid out at this size (in pixels) and scaled into the box on the slide. Resize the box with its handles.
sim.networkHint: Off by default: the page cannot load anything from the internet. Turn it on if it uses a library from a CDN. It never has access to Tiza or your files.

settings.title: Settings
settings.masked: generic name WebKit shows for privacy, not your real GPU
settings.restartQuestion: Tiza will restart to use the selected graphics card. Your unsaved changes will be kept.
settings.gpuHelp: Tiza draws through the system's web engine, which uses the GPU. The integrated GPU is enough for slides, equations and 2D simulations and saves battery. Choose High performance for heavy 3D simulations. If the dedicated GPU fails to start, Tiza goes back to Automatic by itself.
settings.restartManually: Saved. This is a development build, which can't restart itself: close Tiza and run “npm run tauri dev” again to use the selected graphics card.
settings.singleGpu: This computer has a single graphics card.

notes.title: Speaker notes
notes.placeholder: Notes for this slide (only you see them, in the presenter view)…

present.blackShowing: The audience sees a black screen
present.whiteShowing: The audience sees a white screen
present.twoScreensHint: The other screen shows your presenter view: notes, next slide and timer.
present.oneScreenHint: With one screen there is only the audience view. Connect a projector or use “Rehearse in windows”.

import.done: Imported {{count}} slides. Save the presentation to keep it as a .tiza file.
import.error: The file could not be imported: {{message}}

video.autoplay: Play automatically when the slide appears
video.hint: Double-click the video to play it in the editor. When presenting it has controls and clicking it doesn't change slide. WebM plays everywhere; MP4 needs the system's codecs on Linux.

table.hint: {{rows}} rows × {{cols}} columns. Large tables scroll inside the box (also while presenting). Double-click to edit; Enter moves down, Tab moves right.

build.title: Animation
build.hint: Like \pause in Beamer: each click reveals the next step before moving to the next slide.

mcp.title: AI agents (MCP)
mcp.enable: Let AI agents edit the open presentation
mcp.help: Turns on an MCP server on this computer (127.0.0.1 only, protected by a token). Agents such as Claude Code or Claude Desktop can then create and edit slides live while you watch. Every change the agent makes can be undone with Ctrl+Z.
mcp.stopped: Not running (the port may be in use: try another one).
mcp.commandHint: Paste the command in a terminal to connect Claude Code. Making a new token disconnects agents that use the old one.
mcp.tokenHelp: Secret that agents send to prove they may edit. Making a new one disconnects the agents configured with the old one; configure them again.

ribbon.selectToAnimate: Select one or more elements on the slide to animate them.
ribbon.fileDefaultHint: Slides without their own transition use it.

how.claudeCode: Anthropic's coding agent in the terminal.
how.codex: OpenAI's coding agent. Its configuration file:
how.antigravity: Google's agentic IDE. Its configuration file:

about.tagline: Offline presentations for science and teaching: LaTeX, video, simulations and AI agents.

embed.title: Insert from the web
embed.help: Paste the link or the embed code of a YouTube video or an X (Twitter) post.
embed.supported: Recognized: YouTube videos and X posts.
embed.invalid: This isn't a YouTube or X link.
embed.online: It plays in the service's own player, so it needs internet when presenting.
embed.howX: on the post, Share → “Copy link”, or ⋯ → “Embed post” → “Copy Code”.

export.pdfSteps: Export to PDF, one page per click…
export.htmlHint: → / click: next · ← : back · F: full screen
